export_policy: allowlist; no history, runtime, private evidence or corpus locations
sanitation: bounded maintainer-path and credential-marker scan passed on new/changed files
sanitation_reuse: saved equality retained via immutable source/baseline/current Git blob identities; no repeated payload comparison, scan or hash
lumen_source_gate: unchanged vendor evidence reused; pinned Settings.swift update uses its separate one-file receipt
limitation: Pattern inspection is not proof that arbitrary confidential text cannot exist

post_export_amendment.kind: preserve existing published baseline version constants

sanitation_counts_scope: Original base export; post_export_amendment records the separate version-preservation delta

release_candidate.sanitation: Existing export receipt reused; release metadata and notes are a separate reviewed delta
